name: Tagine
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: 1. Heat olive oil in a pot or tagine dish.
2. Add onions and garlic and sauté until soft.
3. Add the meat and fry lightly until it changes colour.
4. Add spices, salt, and pepper, then stir well.
5. Add chopped tomatoes and cook for a few minutes.
6. Pour in water or stock and cover.
7. Allow to simmer on low heat until the meat becomes tender.
8. Add carrots, potatoes, olives, or dried fruits if using.
9. Continue cooking slowly until the sauce becomes thick.
10. Remove from heat and serve hot.

culture.text: A tagine or tajine, also tajin or tagin is a Moroccan stew, named for the earthenware pot in which it is cooked. The pot consists of two parts: a shallow, circular clay skillet and a tall cone- or dome-shaped cover. This cover captures and returns condensation during cooking, so the ingredients are braised with minimal water. The stew typically combines spiced meat, poultry or fish with vegetables or fruit. Tagine recipes include tajine zitoun, tajine mtewem, and tajine lham-lahlou.
